map.速度因数 dn=内径 d×转速 n；脂润滑补脂周期=clamp(300000/√: Speed factor dn = bore d × speed n; grease re-grease interval = clamp(300000/√dn, 250, 8000)h, replacement = re-grease×5 (cap 40000h); oil change = clamp(600000/√dn, 2000, 15000)h. dn>3e5 suggests oil lube, >1.5e5 watch temperature rise.
map.内径 45mm、转速 1450rpm、脂润滑：dn=65250（≈0.65×10: Bore 45mm, speed 1450rpm, grease: dn=65250 (≈0.65×10⁵, normal), re-grease ≈1174h (~1.63 months), replacement ≈5872h (~8.16 months); dn normal, routine maintenance suffices.
map.dn 偏高为什么要改油润滑？: Why switch to oil when dn is high?
map.dn 越高发热与搅油损失越大，脂润滑散热与保持能力下降；dn>1.5e5 温升明: Higher dn means more heat and churning loss; grease lubrication loses heat dissipation and retention. dn>1.5e5 shows clear temperature rise, >3e5 should switch to oil or circulating lubrication.
map.补脂和更换周期为什么差 5 倍？: Why is re-grease 5× the replacement interval?
map.脂润滑运行中逐步劣化，定期补脂维持稠度，达到约 5 倍补脂周期时油脂性能已大幅下: Grease degrades gradually in service; periodic re-greasing maintains consistency, and at about 5× the re-grease interval the grease performance has dropped sharply, requiring cleaning and refill (replacement), hence replacement = re-grease×5.
map.电机轴承维护周期计算器根据轴承内径与转速求得速度因数 dn，结合脂润滑或油润滑方: Motor bearing maintenance-interval calculator uses the bearing bore and speed to obtain the speed factor dn, and with grease or oil lubrication estimates the re-lubrication (grease/top-up/oil-change) and full-replacement intervals, converted to days and months for easy maintenance planning.
